verdict.rationale: The evidence shows installation instructions (pip install claude-agent-sdk), a quickstart guide, and example repos/cookbooks, but no documented one-command scaffolding CLI or template generator (e.g., an 'init' or 'create-agent' command) for bootstrapping a new Agent SDK project. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The story requires a one-command official scaffold (CLI or template); the Opus rationale concedes nothing in the pack shows a dedicated scaffolding command or starter template — the credit rests on a demos repo and pip install, which are adjacent, not ABOUT scaffolding. Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
